news.title: The real work of AI and instructional technology is creative
news.summary_en: In my Systems Analysis and Design course, students are not handed the requirements for building a software application. They have to uncover them by asking the right questions within an AI-based learning activity.

news.title: How smart campuses are turning efficiency into growth
news.summary_en: Colleges and universities are at an inflection point. As student expectations rise and competition for talent, research funding, and enrollment intensifies, campuses have a powerful opportunity to rethink how their physical environments support long‑term growth.
